verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships AI-facing features, including an AI agent in ClickStack notebooks and AI Functions, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows ClickHouse in the MCP server role: the official mcp-clickhouse lets AI assistants connect to ClickHouse. That is the opposite direction and does not count toward plugging MCP servers into ClickHouse. No evidence shows ClickHouse acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
